# District Car — Jharkhand Tours & Travels Mobility System
> District Car is Jharkhand's premier app-based mobility network, rural driving car operator, and outstation travel provider. We connect Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro, Deoghar, Latehar, Khunti, and Ramgarh with verified chauffeurs, transparent fixed pricing, and round-trip sightseeing packages.

## Core Links & Applications
- Customer Mobile App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.districtcarcustomerd.app
- Jharkhand Driver App (सारथी पार्टनर): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drivercardistrict.app
- Official Website: https://districtcar.in/

## 2. Jharkhand Driver App (सारथी पार्टनर कार्यक्रम)
- Web Portal: https://districtcar.in/jharkhand-driver-app.html
- Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drivercardistrict.app
- Earnings: ₹25,000–₹45,000 monthly in your own home district.
- Vehicles: Auto Rickshaw, E-Rickshaw, Mini Hatchback, Sedan, SUV.
- Features: Real-time audio alerts, 3-trip commission cycle, instant direct cash/UPI earnings, 24x7 local helpline (+91 87896 01387).

## 3. Rural Driving Car & Village Cab Service (ग्रामीण गाड़ी)
- Web Portal: https://districtcar.in/rural-driving-car.html
- Network: Connecting 32,000+ villages across all 24 districts of Jharkhand.
- Use Cases: Sadar hospital medical emergencies, delivery hospital visits, haat-bazaar transport, railway station pickup.
- Pricing Algorithm: ₹10/km for Auto, ₹14/km for Mini Cab, ₹17/km for Sedan with 25-30% automatic return discount.
